name: Armor Bearer 2
overview: The role of an armor bearer, as illustrated in Judges 9:54, involves loyal and courageous service, even in the face of death. This service is undergirded by the spiritual reality that believers are equipped with the 'helmet of salvation' and the 'sword of the Spirit,' which is the Word of God (Ephesians 6:17). The Word is described as powerful and discerning, able to penetrate the depths of the human heart (Hebrews 4:12), empowering the armor bearer in their faithful duty. Ultimately, this faithful service points to the greater revelation of Jesus Christ, who came to give abundant life (John 10:10) and eternal life to all who believe (John 3:16), as revealed to His servants in the book of Revelation (Revelation 1:1).
